subject: Harmonia Health: onsite week travel squeeze — proposed demo replan
messages:
From: Dr. Claire Reynolds <claire.reynolds@harmoniahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Harmonia Field Ops <fieldops@harmoniahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 08:34:12 -0700
Subject: Onsite week — request to lock demo during site tour

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for coordinating — our team will be on a multi-site field tour the week of Aug 30 (hospitals in the NE corridor). Travel has just been extended by Operations, and our calendar windows are tighter than expected. We were hoping to lock a 30–45 minute demo of Redwood during the tour; originally we eyed Aug 31 around lunchtime, but that slot is now blocked by site walkthroughs.

Can you share a short set of alternative times? Ideally something during the following windows (site hours below):
- Tue Aug 31: 12:00–13:00 (tight, maybe impossible)
- Wed Sep 1: 09:00–11:00 or 16:00–17:30
- Fri Sep 3: 14:00–16:00

If none of those work, we may need a short pre-recorded overview plus a 20-minute live Q&A at a later date — Ops is trying to minimize any cross-site handoffs. I've attached the (working) itinerary for the tour.

Apologies for the late notice — the extension came through this morning. CCing my field ops lead so you have the on-the-ground context.

Best,
Claire
Dr. Claire Reynolds
Director, Clinical Ops
Harmonia Health

Attachments: harmonia_site-itinerary.pdf (10 pages, calendar export)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Claire Reynolds <claire.reynolds@harmoniahealth.com>
Cc: Harmonia Field Ops <fieldops@harmoniahealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 11:05:27 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite week — request to lock demo during site tour

Hi Claire — thanks for the heads up and for sending the itinerary. Totally understand the squeeze. A couple of quick options so we can keep momentum without adding logistics for your team: 

Option A — Live 30 min (preferred):
- Thu Sep 2, 10:00–10:30 PT / 13:00–13:30 ET (we can record)
- Fri Sep 3, 15:00–15:30 PT / 18:00–18:30 ET

Option B — Recorded + live office hours:
- We send a 12–15 minute focused recording tailored to Harmonia (walkthrough + quick ROI notes) by Tue Aug 24.
- Live Q&A: 20 min slot any day Sep 6–9 that suits you.

Ben is on copy and can provide a field backup if you'd prefer an on-site rep for the Q&A. Also attaching a concise 20-min agenda I usually use for clinical ops-focused walkthroughs so you can scan what we'd cover.

If none of those match site constraints, tell me two 45-minute windows that work for the week of Sep 6 and we'll prioritize availability.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0189

Attachments: redwood-demo-20min-agenda.pdf (1 page)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Dr. Claire Reynolds <claire.reynolds@harmoniahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 13:46:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite week — request to lock demo during site tour

Claire — quick note from me: if your team is split across sites, happy to be the field backup for a short hybrid session (join from a hospital admin station or our side via tablet). I can also bring an on-site one-pager covering integration and compliance checklists if that helps Ops during gaps.

If you go with the recorded + Q&A path, we can:
- Share the recording as an unlisted link (you can circulate to the touring clinicians)
- Schedule a focused 20-minute live Q&A timed to when most stakeholders are back in the office (Sep 6–9 window works on our side today; suggest Sep 8 at 10:30 PT as a hold)

Monica can coordinate logistics and Calendar invites.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: (none in this message)
From: Dr. Claire Reynolds <claire.reynolds@harmoniahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Harmonia Field Ops <fieldops@harmoniahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 10:11:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite week — request to lock demo during site tour

Thanks both — appreciate the flexibility. Ops confirmed the extension through Sep 3 (we're out most of Sep 1–3), so we won't be available for any live demo during the tour. Given that, we'll take Option B: please send the 12–15 minute recording and we'll run it for the team during transit. We'll then join a 20-minute live Q&A on Sep 8 to cover implementation questions and next steps.

Suggested live Q&A hold: Sep 8, 10:30–10:50 PT (13:30–13:50 ET). If that slot becomes problematic for you, say so and we can shift by one business day.

For the recording, please focus on:
- How Redwood handles prefix caching and low-latency routing for multi-site deployments
- Data segregation options for dedicated capacity (we have a compliance checkpoint)
- Short demo of a clinician workflow (3–4 minute example)

I'll attach the updated tour PDF to confirm who will watch the recording at each stop.

Thanks again — Claire
